items.title: Pilot B recorded lower handling time
items.text: Synthetic illustration only: timing supports further evaluation, not a rollout decision.

items.title: Decision
items.text: Decide whether to run a larger controlled evaluation of pilot B.

items.title: Scope
items.text: Two synthetic pilots; 30 cases each. Handling time is the only measured outcome.

items.title: Evaluation criteria
items.text: Compare minutes per case, sample size, and strength of inference. Quality and cost remain unmeasured.

items.title: Approach A
items.text: 12 minutes per case; n = 30. Synthetic pilot A log.

items.title: Approach B
items.text: 9 minutes per case; n = 30. Synthetic pilot B log.

items.title: Common qualification
items.text: Convenience samples were not randomized; case mix may differ.

items.title: Finding
items.text: B recorded 3 fewer minutes per case: (12 − 9) / 12 × 100 = 25% lower than A.

items.title: Interpretation
items.text: The timing difference motivates a controlled follow-up using comparable cases.

items.title: Limits
items.text: This fixture cannot establish causality, statistical significance, quality, cost, or real-world effectiveness.
